title: Kenmore — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Kenmore.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Kenmore Quality." Kenmore is the iconic Sears private-label brand — once the top-selling appliance brand in America. Now owned by Transformco, Kenmore appliances are manufactured by Whirlpool, LG, and others. The brand still commands recognition and loyalty among older homeowners, though distribution has contracted significantly since Sears closures.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Kenmore loyalists replacing old Kenmore units. Customers shopping Sears outlet/online.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Kenmore:

• Iconic American brand — decades of trust and recognition

• Manufactured by major brands (Whirlpool, LG) under Kenmore specs

• Parts widely available through Sears Home Services

• Familiar to older homeowners who grew up with the brand

• Still available online and through Sears channels
